subject.title: add option for MCP apps support

question: Should OpenClaw core host MCP Apps with this iframe/gateway/session trust model, and what security boundary must be enforced before merge?
rationale: This PR adds a new core-hosted app runtime surface with session-bound gateway calls and embedded third-party UI content, so automation cannot choose the acceptable persistence, CSP, and permissions boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Fix boundaries before merge
options.body: Require the contributor to remove sensitive persisted payload/session data, bound resource materialization, enforce resource CSP/permissions, and then refresh the draft branch for security review.

options.title: Accept opt-in risk
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept the default-off feature with documented security limitations, but that would make the current weaker host boundary a product commitment.

options.title: Pause or close for direction
options.body: Pause or close the PR until MCP Apps hosting has an approved core/plugin ownership and security design.

recommendation.title: Fix boundaries before merge
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to remove sensitive persisted payload/session data, bound resource materialization, enforce resource CSP/permissions, and then refresh the draft branch for security review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI and canvas-path hardening history makes this the best available routing owner for the embedded app and persisted canvas boundary decision.
